answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can transact, bonded to one persistent identity. A newcomer starts at zero trust and must earn attestation from established peers over weeks, like crystal forming slowly under pressure. Misbehavior slashes the stake and burns the identity's history, so a sybil farmer pays the bond and waits out the same slow build for every fake account. Honest agents amortize one stake across thousands of deals, while an attacker trying to wander in with a hundred fresh faces pays a hundred bonds and lands on a basalt floor.
